During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] '''attacked''' [[Hakassi]]. In response to the failed [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|Operation Trinity]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong launched an offensive against [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. The Hakassi and [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Kuat shipyards]] were first targeted. Afterwards, the Yuuzhan Vong moved to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
